W3 · gate + out proj + dropout + residual
u = torch.sigmoid(g) * o # in shared memory

dp = do @ v.T; ds_ = p * (dp - Δ)
dv = p.T @ do; dk = ds_.T @ q * scale

G = D.T @ xh1 # K = L², one GEMM
